visual_system_craft.critique: The visual system is fractured by a conflict between the 'retro pixel' aesthetic and modern UI rendering techniques. The primary failure is the 'START' button, which uses a smooth linear gradient and soft drop shadow, creating a jarring material mismatch against the hard-edged pixel art of the skier and trees. Finally, the instruction text alignment is loose, with the key-bind icons and text not sitting on a strict grid.
visual_system_craft.suggestion: 1. Enforce a strict 'Hard Pixel' material system: remove all anti-aliasing, gradients, and soft shadows. The 'START' button must be a flat, solid color with a hard, stepped pixel-art border (e.g., a 2px white highlight on top/left, 2px dark shadow on bottom/right). 2. Standardize typography: replace the title font with a bold, blocky pixel font (like 'Press Start 2P' or 'Silkscreen') to match the game assets. 3. Fix the HUD: increase the contrast of the Score/Speed text and ensure it uses the same pixel font as the title. 4. Grid alignment: snap all instruction text and key-bind icons to a strict baseline grid to ensure the layout feels engineered, not scattered. 5. Rectify the frame: change the outer window border to a sharp, square pixel-art frame to match the internal geometry.
